stories.title: DFB: Pressestimmen zur Niederlage unter Jürgen Klopp – »Griechische Tragödie«

en.title: DFB: Press reactions to defeat under Jürgen Klopp – 'Greek tragedy'
en.summary: Germany's national football team earned just one point from two matches under new coach Jürgen Klopp, with international media describing the start as inauspicious and the promised revolution in German football still awaited.

en.title: Nations League: Greece beats Germany 1:0
en.summary: Germany's national football team lost their home debut under new coach Jürgen Klopp to Greece in a 1:0 defeat, marking the first loss against Greece in eleven encounters.

stories.title: Nations League: Deutschland gegen Griechenland: Erste Pleite für Jürgen Klopp als Bundestrainer

en.title: Nations League: Germany against Greece: First defeat for Jürgen Klopp as national coach
en.summary: Germany's national football team suffered their first loss to Greece under new coach Jürgen Klopp in his second match, though the coach remained calm while television expert Bastian Schweinsteiger offered criticism.

en.title: Press reactions: 'Greek tragedy for Klopp'
en.summary: International media commented on new coach Jürgen Klopp's home debut, with many outlets describing the start as inauspicious.

stories.title: Uefa Nations League: Deutsche Nationalelf verliert gegen Griechenland

en.title: Uefa Nations League: German national team loses to Greece
en.summary: Germany's national team lost to Greece in a Nations League match. Manager Jürgen Klopp made several lineup changes in his home debut but was unable to secure a victory.

stories.title: Nations League: Griechenland zieht Klopp den Stecker

en.title: Nations League: Greece stops Klopp
en.summary: Greece scored the decisive goal in a sluggish match to defeat Germany. Jürgen Klopp suffered a loss in his home premiere as national team manager.

stories.title: OB-Wahl in Hannover: Grünen-Politiker Belit Onay gewinnt Bürgermeisterstichwahl in Hannover

en.title: Mayor election in Hannover: Green politician Belit Onay wins mayoral runoff in Hannover
en.summary: Belit Onay, a Green Party politician, won the mayoral runoff in Hannover following a previous municipal election in Lower Saxony. The incumbent mayor was decisively reelected to his position.

en.title: Parliamentary election in Serbia: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić steps down
en.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić announced his resignation halfway through his mandate. He intends to transition from the presidency to the position of prime minister.

stories.title: Anstehende Wahlen: Serbiens Präsident Vučić tritt zurück — und will Ministerpräsident werden

en.title: Upcoming Elections: Serbia's President Vučić Steps Down — and Wants to Become Prime Minister
en.summary: Serbian President Vučić is resigning ahead of parliamentary elections to pursue the position of prime minister. Analysts view this maneuver as an attempt to consolidate his political power.

stories.title: Serbien: Präsident Aleksandar Vučić tritt zurück

en.title: Serbia: President Aleksandar Vučić Steps Down
en.summary: Serbia's partially autocratic president has resigned and transferred his office to a political ally. The move enables Vučić to pursue his next objective of becoming head of government.
